notes.zh-CN: 小米语音遥控器的听写改为在这台 Mac 上完成，音频不再上传。请在系统设置中允许语音识别，并下载离线听写语言。配对密钥失效时不再反复重连，会提示忽略遥控器后重新配对。手机可以从相册选择图片，包括 iOS 的 HEIC。macOS 为 universal 开发签名、未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 为 debug 签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队已注册设备。
notes.en: Xiaomi remote dictation now stays on this Mac and the audio is not uploaded. Allow Speech Recognition in System Settings and download an offline dictation language. A rejected Bluetooth bond stops reconnecting and asks you to forget the remote, then pair it again. The phone can attach album photos, including iOS HEIC. macOS is universal and development-signed, not notarized; Windows installers are unsigned; APK is debug-signed; IPA is development-signed for registered team devices only.
